Name: (AT) (CP) Better Chickens for 1.6
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

I love to use [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TurmionKala/mods?gameId=1303]TurmionKala [/url][url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases.][/url][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TurmionKala/mods?gameId=1303][/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8253]Better Chickens[/url]﻿﻿ mod, however it currently uses the outdated version of content patcher and doesn't have alternative textures compat & there's no plans for it to be updated. So I've updated it to 1.6 alongside adding some new sprites!

There's two versions to choose from: The content patcher version and the alternative textures version. Both come with the retexture to Marnie's shop icon sprite too! (configurable in GMCM) - so there will be a content patcher file in both mods.

This mod also adds the 'Alternative Eye Style' to the Blue, Void and Golden Chicken! AND baby sprites!

Let me know if there's any bugs or if you'd like me to add anything!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher or Alternative Textures mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img]
[/url]
Using the GMCM you can enable/disable any sprite for easy compatibility with other mods :) and you can choose
between the normal and alternative eyes styles


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece/mods?gameId=1303][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/94376493]TurmionKala[/url] ﻿for the original amazing artwork & the asset use permissions to allow the use of editing assets without permission (but with credit) in order to add compatibility with 1.6, AT and the updated content patcher format :)

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
